title: First Rectifiability Theorem 8.1.2
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on open U ⊆ ℝ^N such that for μ_V-a.e. x there are T ∈ G(N,n) and θ with HasTangentPlane V x T θ (Def. 1.1: x ∈ U, θ > 0, V_{x,λ} → θ v(T) as λ ↓ 0 against C_c(ℝ^N × G)). Let M := {x ∈ spt μ_V : ∃ T θ', HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}. Then there is θ : ℝ^N → ℝ such that for every x ∈ M some T satisfies HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x), and IsVarifoldOf V M θ: M ⊆ U is H^n-null-measurable and countably n-rectifiable, θ > 0 on M, θ is H^n-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U, and V(A) = ∫_{{x ∈ M : ∃ S, M has approximate tangent plane S at x w.r.t. θ (Ch. 3 1.7), (x,S) ∈ A}} θ dH^n for all Borel A. (Exactly FirstRectifiabilityTheorem.)
